description: Tell the SurfCAD tab which phase the user's prompt is in. responding (alias typing) is the ack: call set_status { state: "responding", id } first after read_messages returns a prompt, before any other tool. The chat stays open with bouncing dots. Then one short non-final reply_to_user. The tab holds that reply for 10 seconds. building (alias working): you are creating or editing geometry. A building call, post_progress, or model-changing tool during that hold waits, then the chat folds and the field shows "Agent is working..." (on a phone, the Bot button spins). Call set_status { state: "building" } only once you have everything you need and are actually creating or editing geometry. Do not call building to list parts, faces, edges, or transforms, or for status or read_messages. A model-changing tool also enters building if you skip this call. A read never does. set_status is for progress and does not close the task. A partial reply does not leave building; the final reply, Stop, or a disconnect does. reply_to_user { final: true } stops the spinner, reopens the chat, and idles. No activity for 15 minutes, while responding or building, shows the stall notice and leaves Stop up. set_status, a model-changing tool, post_progress, and reply_to_user are activity; a read_messages poll is not. The result state is the tab value (responding and typing are typing; building and working are working). Without id it targets the latest prompt. With no prompt at all (a build you started yourself, or a prompt an earlier one-shot process read) the tab still shows the state: it keeps a session-level state fed by this call, by every model-changing tool you call, and by post_progress, and it returns to idle 60 s after the last of those. A cancelled id returns { ok: false, error: cancelled }. When you finish a task started from the SurfCAD in-viewer prompt pane, send a closing reply with reply_to_user (final: true) summarising what was done, so the user gets confirmation. On failure or partial completion, say what was done, what failed and why, and what is left.

id.description: Optional prompt id this status refers to.

label.description: Optional short text for the tab, for example what you are working on.

state.description: responding: bouncing dots, chat stays open (alias typing). building: you are creating or editing geometry and the field shows Agent is working (alias working). Call building only once you are actually modeling. idle: not responding or building. Idle does not close the task; a closing reply_to_user does.

working.description: Legacy form of state: true is building (working), false is idle. Use state.

name: set_status
